readings: reset is active-high: count clears to 0 when reset=1
reset is active-low: count clears to 0 when reset=0
counter saturates at the bounds: holds at 65535 on increment overflow and holds at 0 on decrement underflow
reset has priority: when reset is active, count becomes 0 regardless of up_down
up_down has priority: when reset is active and up_down=1, count increments instead of resetting
count is the internal counter register and updates on the same clk edge as the counter state
count is a separate output register, so it is delayed by one clk cycle relative to the internal counter state
